companyDescription: Search · Cloud · AI — Google Search/YouTube cash engine + Gemini/TPU + fast-growing Google Cloud. Wide-moat data & distribution flywheel.
priceNote: fwd P/E ~24 — ถูกกว่า quality peers ทั้งที่ Cloud + AI โตเร่ง
summary: Alphabet is the highest-scoring quality-core DCA pick: a wide-moat cash machine (Search + YouTube) re-rating on Cloud and Gemini/TPU momentum, yet still trading at a forward P/E (~24) below its own history and below peer quality. Best combination of durable moat + reasonable valuation in the screen.

catalysts.name: Cloud margin expansion + AI compute
catalysts.description: Google Cloud profitability and AI product traction (Gemini, custom TPUs) are the multi-year compounding drivers — not a single-date event.

risks: Antitrust / regulatory overhang (search remedies, ad-tech case)
AI capex cycle pressures near-term free cash flow
Search disruption risk from AI chat competitors

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Net-cash balance sheet + huge FCF make Alphabet resilient to rate moves.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Ad pricing power and cost discipline offset input inflation.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Long-duration growth, but cash generation today cushions multiple compression.
macroRisk.summary: Low Fed sensitivity for a mega-cap with fortress cash flow — a core holding can ride rate cycles.

valuationBand.basis: fwd P/E ~24 vs Alphabet's own ~30x history + consensus median target $430; fair-value studies $377–432

qualityScore.note: Search/YouTube distribution moat, expanding op margins, massive FCF, net cash.

dcaPlan.note: DCA monthly; double the lot on 8%+ dips into the Accumulate band.

technicalNote.note: Trades above a rising 200-DMA in mid-2026 — uptrend intact; entries fine on any pullback.

thesisBreak: Structural Search query/share loss to AI competitors for 2+ quarters
Adverse antitrust remedy that forces material divestiture or changes default-search economics
Operating margin erosion as AI capex outruns monetization

stopLoss.rrNote: DCA exits on thesis-break, not a daily stop

entryStrategy.verdict: Top quality-core pick — wide moat at a fair price. DCA monthly, add hard on dips.

th.summary: Alphabet ได้คะแนน DCA สูงสุดในรอบนี้ — เครื่องผลิตเงินสด moat กว้าง (Search + YouTube) กำลัง re-rate จาก Cloud และ Gemini/TPU แต่ยังเทรดที่ fwd P/E ~24 ต่ำกว่าค่าเฉลี่ยตัวเองและต่ำกว่า quality peer. ส่วนผสม moat + valuation ดีที่สุดในลิสต์.
